login.title: Sign in to your server
login.starting: Asking your account for a code…
login.instruction: On your phone or computer, open {url} and enter this code:
login.waiting: This screen carries on by itself once you have entered it.
login.expired: The code ran out before it was entered. Ask for a new one and try again.
login.failed: Your account could not be reached. Check the box is online, then try again.

home.empty: This server has nothing in it yet.

error.unreachable: The server cannot be reached. It may be switched off, or the box may be off the network.
error.signedOut: The server no longer accepts this sign-in. Sign in again to carry on.
error.noServer: This account has no server the box can reach.
error.unknown: Something went wrong talking to the server.

person.empty: Nothing else with {name} is on this server.
person.partial: The server did not say how many there are, so this list may be short.

player.hint: Left/Right: jump · OK: pause · Down: audio and subtitles · Back: pause
player.hintPaused: OK: carry on · Down: audio and subtitles · Back: stop

settings.autologinOffHint: The box asks who is watching each time it starts.
